title: 高松宮記念の後に・才能の証明

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is showered with praise as we reflect on the great efforts that brought us here. She's delighted that her talents have been conveyed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon after, King Halo encounters Kawakami Princess in the waiting room, who excitedly states her newfound desire to win the Takamatsunomiya Kinen as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having come to this realization herself not long ago, King Halo advises her to find what she really wants to do, and become first-rate at that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, King Halo sets her sights on the Yasuda Kinen. With no intention of stopping, she looks ahead with a fearless smile.
